The phone appears to be a Samsung Galaxy Note series device based on the camera layout and overall design.

The seller claims it is a 'Samsung galaxy note20' with a 'small cracked' screen.

proof_requests: Close-up video or photo of the screen turned on, showing full display and touch functionality.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Samsung Galaxy Note20 with a small screen crack, as claimed. The photos support the identity and condition. Hidden risks exist but are priced conservatively as worst-case until proven otherwise.
